title: with-resources
responsibility: Builds the argument vector for running a command through the Harness resource-admission CLI, applying validated priority and resource environment overrides without shell interpolation.

inputs.name: resourceArguments.args
inputs.description: The wrapper arguments in the form `<priority> -- <command...>`: the first argument must be exactly `coding`, `agent-test`, or `environment`, the second must be exactly `--`, and at least one argument must follow it. Arguments after `--` are copied into the output unchanged and are not otherwise checked.

inputs.name: resourceArguments.env
inputs.description: The environment map is consulted only for `HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY`, `HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS`, and `HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB`: an unset or empty `HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY` falls back to the positional priority, an unset or empty `HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS` falls back to `1`, and an unset or empty `HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB` falls back to `2048`. Non-empty values are passed through unchecked, so a `HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY` outside `coding`, `agent-test`, and `environment` is not rejected.

outputs.name: resourceArguments
outputs.description: The argument vector for the `resources run` CLI: `resources`, `run`, `--priority`, the priority, `--cpus`, the CPU count, `--memory-mib`, the memory MiB, `--`, then the command arguments unchanged. The priority is `HARNESS_RESOURCE_PRIORITY` when non-empty and the positional priority otherwise, the CPU count is `HARNESS_RESOURCE_CPUS` when non-empty and `1` otherwise, and the memory MiB is `HARNESS_RESOURCE_MEMORY_MIB` when non-empty and `2048` otherwise. The canonical full-check command also adds the Full repository check label and selects agent-test priority on macOS. No shell string is constructed.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown as an `Error` with the message `Usage: with-resources <coding|agent-test|environment> -- <command...>` when the first argument is not `coding`, `agent-test`, or `environment`, the second is not `--`, or no argument follows `--`.
